title: leandra alloeotricha

The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Leandra alloeotricha include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
